entities.title: Move generation against perft counts
entities.summary: The number of legal move sequences from known positions matches the published perft counts.
criteria: The start position to depth 3, Kiwipete to depth 2 and positions 3, 4 and 5 give their published counts

entities.title: SAN, results and draws
entities.summary: Fool's mate, promotion, castling, disambiguation, threefold repetition, an illegal move and insufficient material.
criteria: Fool's mate ends 0-1 by checkmate and is written f3 e5 g4 Qh4#
A capture promoting to a queen is written bxa8=Q; castling moves the rook and is written O-O
Knights on the same rank are told apart by file (Neg5)
Repeating a position three times draws by repetition
e2e5 from the start is refused
King and bishop against king is insufficient material; king and rook is not
entities.details: The fifty-move rule and stalemate have no test of their own here.
